title: kactivitymanagerd database does not clear its data when "Clear History" is chosen from "Security & Privacy > Recent Files"
line: Clear History in Recent Files now removes every record of the cleared files, including files that are still open.
explanation: Clear History deleted only events whose end time fell in the chosen span, so a file that was opened but never reported as closed (end still empty) kept its event. The ResourceInfo row (path, title, mimetype) was only deleted for files with such an event, so it survived for those files and for files known only through a title or mimetype. Now open events are deleted too, and after every clear (and the periodic old-history cleanup) ResourceInfo rows that no event, score or activity link refers to are removed.

commits.message:
plugins/sqlite: remove all traces of cleared resources

Clearing recent history kept events of files that were opened but never
closed, and the ResourceInfo rows of files without such an event. Delete
open events too, then drop the ResourceInfo rows nothing refers to.

BUG: 508766

media.caption: Before: after 'Forget the last hour' the opened-but-not-closed file still has its ResourceInfo and ResourceEvent rows
After: the same steps leave only the file linked to an activity, which is not history
